retrievalProfile.description: Creates a high-contrast 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a central fashion figure in leather and denim against a dark vignetted background with bold neon pink sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: neon pink block lettering on dark background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a blonde figure in profile wearing a heavily studded black leather jacket and distressed denim, set against a dark, smoky grey vignetted background, framed by vibrant magenta-pink typography in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset to the left
High contrast between neon pink text and dark background
Texture contrast between metallic studs and soft hair
Diagonal balance between top-left corner sash and bottom-right text
coreInvariants: Vibrant magenta-pink (#FF00FF) as the primary typographic color
Dark, textured studio backdrop with heavy vignetting
Subject wearing a black leather jacket with silver metallic studs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium shot from waist up, turned in profile looking back over the shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blonde hair and the metallic sheen of the studded jacket shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left pink sash, moves down the subject's back to the denim, then up to the large name in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark, textured space surrounding the subject to allow text to pop.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink accents against low-saturation, low-value background tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and scales across the layout.
graphicDevices: Diagonal corner sash/ribbon in top-left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and tight spacing seen in the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person in a studded black leather jacket and jeans, shot in profile against a dark, smoky grey vignetted background. Leave the top-right and bottom-right corners clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in neon magenta-pink in the top-right and bottom-right corners. Add a diagonal magenta sash in the top-left corner with smaller white or pink text inside.

verificationChecks: Is the background dark and vignetted?
Is the typography a bold, condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Density of the studs on the jacket
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background
Check that the pink color is vibrant and not muted
Verify the subject's pose is a profile or three-quarter view
Confirm the presence of the diagonal corner element
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Material] jacket + [Dark Vignette] background + [Neon Pink Condensed Sans-Serif] typography.
